props.title: DOCX Export
props.description: Edit data in the table below, then click Download DOCX to export it as a Word document — demonstrates renderGeneric with separate React and DOCX specs sharing one store.
props.technicalDescription:
Spec
React: CaseContainer → { BoundField(title), Table → [THead → Tr → Th×3, TBody(repeat:/rows) → Tr → [Td → BoundField×3]] }
DOCX: Document → Section → { Heading($state:/title), DocxTable(repeat:/rows) → TableRow → TableCell → Paragraph($item:field) }
State
{ title, rows: [{ id, name, qty, price }], generatedAt }
Features
• Two specs — React spec for interactive preview, DOCX spec for export, both using the same store
• renderGeneric — walks the DOCX spec tree, passes raw props + ctx to registry functions
• Expression resolution in registry — resolve() helper reads $state/$item from store via ctx
• ctx.basePath scoping — inside repeat, resolve() composes absolute paths from ctx.basePath
• docx builders — registry maps spec types to Document, Section, Paragraph, Table, TableRow, TableCell
• Packer.toBlob + browser download — one-click .docx generation
